_comment: Koaai — single-process Rust Discord music bot. Requires the release binary URL; see pterodactyl/README.md
name: Koaai (Rust music bot)
author: kurenai@koaai.dev
description: Single-process Discord music bot written in Rust. Downloads the koaai binary, installs yt-dlp nightly and Node.js, then runs the bot with graceful SIGINT shutdown.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -ex

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl xz-utils python3-minimal python3-pip

# yt-dlp — project requires a recent build; prefer prereleases (nightly channel)
python3 -m pip install --upgrade --pre yt-dlp \
  || python3 -m pip install --upgrade --pre yt-dlp --break-system-packages
ln -sf "$(command -v yt-dlp)" /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp
yt-dlp --version

# Node.js runtime (passed to every yt-dlp call via --js-runtimes node)
mkdir -p /mnt/server/bin
cd /tmp
NODE_VERSION=22.14.0
curl -sSL -o node.tar.xz "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz"
tar -xf node.tar.xz
cp "node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64/bin/node" /mnt/server/bin/node
/mnt/server/bin/node --version

# koaai binary
cd /mnt/server
if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
    curl -sSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" -o koaai "${KOAAI_DOWNLOAD_URL}"
else
    curl -sSL -o koaai "${KOAAI_DOWNLOAD_URL}"
fi
chmod +x koaai
file koaai

echo "installation complete"

variables.name: Binary download URL
variables.description: Direct URL of the koaai binary from GitHub Actions artifacts or a GitHub Release asset

variables.name: GitHub token
variables.description: Personal access token — REQUIRED if the repo/release is private

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: Discord user ID of the bot owner (report dashboard access in DMs)

variables.name: Dev guild ID
variables.description: Scope slash-command registration to one guild while testing (leave empty for global)
